title: EventBus failure recovery next emit contract

contract.failure_isolation: A listener failure during one emit does not prevent subsequent listeners from receiving the event
contract.next_emit_recovery: A later emit remains fully operational after a previous listener failure
contract.ordering: Listener delivery order remains stable across emits
contract.registry_stability: Listener failures do not mutate the listener registry
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged across failed and successful deliveries
